import sys

MOD = 998244353

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    n, m, l, r = map(int, data[:4])
    k = n * m
    length = r - l + 1
    if k % 2 == 1:
        ans = pow(length, k, MOD)
    else:
        ans = (pow(length, k, MOD) + pow(length % 2, k, MOD)) * pow(2, MOD - 2, MOD) % MOD
    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
